#!/usr/bin/env node
'use strict';
// A stand-in for mocha in the benchmark, which installs no packages: it runs the files in test/ with
// describe and it (it.skip leaves a test out), prints each test, then "N passing" and "N failing" as
// mocha does, and exits 1 when a test failed.
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const tests = [];
const names = [];
global.describe = (name, body) => {
  names.push(name);
  body();
  names.pop();
};
global.it = (name, fn) => tests.push({ name: [...names, name].join(' '), fn });
global.it.skip = () => {};

const dir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'test');
for (const file of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((name) => name.endsWith('.js')).sort()) require(path.join(dir, file));
let failing = 0;
for (const test of tests) {
  try {
    test.fn();
    process.stdout.write(`  ok ${test.name}\n`);
  } catch (error) {
    failing += 1;
    process.stdout.write(`  ${failing}) ${test.name}: ${error.message}\n`);
  }
}
process.stdout.write(`\n  ${tests.length - failing} passing\n${failing ? `  ${failing} failing\n` : ''}`);
process.exitCode = failing ? 1 : 0;
